crossRefs.note: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
“No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
“I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
“Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
“Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

parallels.note: Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.

translations.web: Look at this. We have searched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
translations.bsb: Indeed, we have investigated, and it is true! So hear it and know for yourself.”
translations.kjv: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know
translations.asv: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; Hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
